scope: Best candidate found in the declared local screening set, not a global optimum

gsq.selection: Lowest combined warm code-task time among screened configurations passing both code tasks; single-seed selection requires held-out validation

nvfp4.recipe: current worker-q4-dual.ps1 -Nvfp4, window overridden to common value
nvfp4.selection: Incumbent measured decoder recipe; sampler 1.0 beat 0.6 in the screening episode with both code fixtures passing, and fewer visible Thai defects

exl3.recipe: Profile G native TP, cq4, gs9,15.5, MTP ndt3; common window overrides cs262144
exl3.selection: Best-known locally measured served recipe; no claim that every possible EXL3 setting was retuned

limitations: EXL3 may not honor the requested seed; pairing is by workload and rotated round, not assumed common random numbers
Summary replay is repeated, while the two code tasks are held out from configuration selection
These are single-answer tasks with external execution checks, not full autonomous repository-editing jobs
Language repair and future optimizations remain separate from raw functional pass rate
